name: jev
description: Puts a fast calibrated classifier at the harness boundaries: escalates risky tool calls to a permission prompt, flags tool results that read like prompt injection, and catches a turn that stops short of the work it was asked to do. Escalate-only and fail-open.

api_key.title: TypeSafe API key
api_key.description: Key for TypeSafe's Jev API, issued at https://typesafe.ai. Without it the judgment hooks stay inactive and only the deterministic pattern checks run.

gate_mode.title: Tool-call gate
gate_mode.description: off: no PreToolUse gate. standard: judge writes outside the project, sensitive paths, unrecognized shell commands, and MCP tools with unknown effects. strict: also judge ordinary edits inside the project, and treat any uncertain signal as a reason to ask.

auto_mode.title: In auto mode
auto_mode.description: What a confirm-grade judgment does while the session is in auto mode. advise: add a note to Claude's context and let Claude Code's auto-mode classifier decide, with no prompt. ask: prompt anyway. Out-of-scope actions that are destructive or outward-facing, and the hard-coded patterns like rm -rf ~, prompt either way.

stop_check.title: Check the final message before stopping
stop_check.description: When the final message of a turn says part of the requested work is unfinished and is not waiting on you, ask Claude to continue. At most one block per prompt.

screen_results.title: Screen fetched text for injected instructions
screen_results.description: Judge WebFetch, WebSearch and MCP tool results for text that gives orders to an AI agent, and tell Claude to treat such a result as data. Never blocks and never rewrites the result.

route_prompts.title: Classify each prompt
route_prompts.description: Add one advisory line naming the kind of task a prompt is asking for, and whether it reads as ambiguous. Off by default: it costs a call on every prompt.

auto_threshold.title: Certainty threshold
auto_threshold.description: Probability at or above which a signal counts as established. Lower means more prompts. 0.85 is the default; /jev:calibrate replays your own log at other values.
